title: South Eastern Coalfields IPO
summary: South Eastern Coalfields IPO is a book-built issue of 66.81 crore shares, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: South Eastern Coalfields IPO has a total issue size of 66,80,56,100 shares of ₹2 and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: SBI Capital Markets Ltd., ICICI Securities Ltd., IDBI Capital Markets & Securities Ltd., Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd.

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
South Eastern Coalfields financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

South Eastern Coalfields Limited (SECL) incorporated on November 28, 1985, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited (CIL). SECL engages in coal mining and production operations in India. SECL is one of the largest coal producers in India and the second-largest coal-producing subsidiary of CIL, with a coal production volume of 176.29 million tonnes during the FY 2026, contributing to 16.94% of total coal production of India. The Company is currently operating in Korba, Mand-Raigarh and Central India Coalfields in Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh. As of September 30, 2026, SECL operates in 53 mines, out of which 19 are opencast and 34 are underground mines in 13 operational areas. SECL's major mining facilities include the Gevra and Kusmunda Mines, which are among the world's biggest coal mines based on production capacity. As of April 1, 2026, SECL has geological resources of coal approximating to 47.55 billion tonnes and audited coal reserves of 4.61 billion tonnes. · · As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 35,559 permanent employees and 26,189 outsourced workforce employees.
President of India, acting through the Ministry of Coal, Government of India, Coal India Ltd. are the company's promoters of South Eastern Coalfields.
